camera.title: Live photograph capture
camera.introTitle: We need your camera to take your photograph
camera.introBody: Your photograph is taken live using this device's camera. Uploading a photo from your gallery is not allowed. Your browser will ask for permission next.
camera.tip1: Sit in a well-lit place, facing the light
camera.tip3: Remove cap and dark glasses; keep your face uncovered
camera.tip4: Only you should be visible in the frame
camera.privacy: The camera is used only on this screen and is switched off as soon as the photo is taken.
camera.doneBody: Your photograph has been captured and saved securely.
camera.limitBody: You have used all {{count}} attempts. Please raise a helpdesk ticket if you need more.

issue.NO_FACE: Position your face inside the oval
issue.MULTIPLE_FACES: Only one face should be visible
issue.CENTRE_FACE: Centre your face in the oval
issue.TOO_DARK: Too dark. Move to a brighter place
issue.TOO_BRIGHT: Too bright. Avoid direct light behind or on you
issue.BLURRY: Hold still, the image is blurry

liveness.turn: Now turn your head slightly to one side and back

PERMISSION_DENIED.title: Camera permission was denied
PERMISSION_DENIED.body: We cannot take your photograph without camera access. Allow the camera for this site and try again.

NO_CAMERA.title: No camera found
NO_CAMERA.body: Connect a camera or use a phone with a front camera, then try again.

CAMERA_IN_USE.title: Camera is busy
CAMERA_IN_USE.body: Another app (video call, camera app) is using the camera. Close it and try again.

INSECURE_CONTEXT.title: Secure connection required
INSECURE_CONTEXT.body: The camera works only on a secure (https) connection. Open the portal using its https address.

UNSUPPORTED.title: Browser not supported
UNSUPPORTED.body: Please use the latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari (iOS 15 or later).

MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.title: Could not load face check
MODEL_LOAD_FAILED.body: Please check your internet connection and try again.

UPLOAD_FAILED.title: Could not save photograph
UPLOAD_FAILED.body: Your photo was not saved. Check your connection and try again.

browserSteps.chrome: Click the camera icon in the address bar, choose “Always allow”, then reload.
browserSteps.edge: Click the lock icon in the address bar, set Camera to “Allow”, then reload.
browserSteps.firefox: Click the camera icon in the address bar, remove the block, then reload and allow.
browserSteps.safari-ios: Open Settings > Safari > Camera, choose “Ask” or “Allow”, then reload this page.
browserSteps.safari-mac: Safari > Settings for This Website > Camera: Allow, then reload.
browserSteps.android-chrome: Tap the lock icon > Permissions > Camera > Allow, then reload.
browserSteps.other: Open your browser's site settings, allow the camera for this site, then reload.

signature.title: Signature
signature.drawHint: Sign inside the box with your finger, stylus or mouse.
signature.uploadHint: Sign with black ink on white paper. It will be auto-cropped to 140×60 px, 10 to 20 KB.
signature.tooLarge: File is too large (max 2 MB before processing).

common.wrongType: This file type is not allowed
